blocks.label: Hero
blocks.description: The opening statement of a page: a large heading, a line of text, the main buttons and an optional picture. Use first, once.

blocks.label: Logo row
blocks.description: A quiet row of local makers, builders or partner marks.

blocks.label: Feature grid
blocks.description: Short points with icons in two to four columns: services, benefits, principles.

blocks.label: Text and picture
blocks.description: A heading, text and a short list beside one picture, left or right — the workhorse section.

blocks.label: Figures
blocks.description: Two to four numbers that prove a claim, each with a label and a line of context.

blocks.label: Steps
blocks.description: A numbered process, from first contact to the finished job.

blocks.label: Testimonial
blocks.description: One quotation, set large, with the person and an optional portrait. Once per page.

blocks.label: Testimonials
blocks.description: Several shorter quotes in a grid.

blocks.label: Pricing
blocks.description: Two to four packages or plans with a price, what is included and a button; one can be highlighted.

blocks.label: Questions
blocks.description: Questions and answers that open one at a time. Answers take Markdown.

blocks.label: Gallery
blocks.description: A grid of pictures with optional captions — recent work, the studio, the team at work.

blocks.label: Team
blocks.description: The people from the team collection, everyone or a chosen few, with photo and role.

blocks.label: Latest posts
blocks.description: The newest journal posts as cards, optionally only those with one tag.

blocks.label: Text
blocks.description: A heading and Markdown prose: lists, links, emphasis. For directions, policies and longer explanations.

blocks.label: Call to action
blocks.description: A closing band with one strong heading and one or two buttons. Usually last on a page.

blocks.label: Contact
blocks.description: Ways to reach you beside the contact form. The contact page's main section.

blocks.label: Form
blocks.description: Any form from the forms collection with a heading above or beside it — drop an enquiry or a quote request onto any page.

templates.label: Service page
templates.description: One service in depth: what it covers, how it works, what it costs and the questions people ask.

templates.label: Project story
templates.description: One finished job: the brief, pictures of the result, the client's words and an invitation to talk.

templates.label: About page
templates.description: Who you are, what you believe, the team and some recent work.

templates.label: Contact page
templates.description: The contact form beside your details, and how to find you.

templates.label: Journal post
templates.description: A practical article for the journal: a clear title, a one-line summary, a cover picture and a few short sections.
